map.新船或营运船舶配载核算时，按 LBP、型宽、各站吃水、方形系数与水密度算排水量、: When checking the loading of a new or operating vessel, compute the hydrostatic parameters of displacement, TPC and MTC from LBP, moulded breadth, the draught at each station, the block coefficient and the water density.
map.纵倾计算时，按首尾吃水差算纵倾方向与大小，并用 MTC 估算调整纵倾需移动的重量: For trim calculation, get the direction and size of the trim from the difference between the forward and aft draughts, and use MTC to estimate the weight that must be shifted to adjust the trim.
map.载重能力核算时，用排水量减去空船重量得 DWT，并与航次载货量核对。: For load capacity accounting, subtract the lightship weight from the displacement to get DWT and check it against the cargo quantity for the voyage.
map.100m 干货船静水力示例: Hydrostatic example for a 100 m dry cargo ship
map.LBP=100m、型宽=16m、首/中/尾吃水=5.0/5.2/5.4m、方形系: LBP = 100 m, moulded breadth = 16 m, forward, mid and aft draught = 5.0, 5.2 and 5.4 m, block coefficient 0.7, sea water density 1.025: waterplane coefficient Cw = (2 × 0.7 + 1)/3 = 0.8, mean draught 5.20 m, displacement 5969.6 t, waterplane area 1280 m², TPC = 13.12 t/cm, longitudinal metacentric height GML ≈ 146.5 m, MTC = 87.47 t·m/cm; trim by the stern 0.4 m, and with a lightship of 2000 t, DWT = 3969.6 t; changing the trim by 1 cm requires shifting about 87.5 t.
map.水线面系数怎么取？: How is the waterplane coefficient chosen?
map.未给出时按经验 (2×Cb+1)/3 估算；已知则直接输入，系数影响水线面面积、: When it is not given, estimate it as (2 × Cb + 1)/3 by experience; if it is known, enter it directly. The coefficient affects the waterplane area, TPC and stability.
map.MTC 和 TPC 有什么区别？: What is the difference between MTC and TPC?
map.TPC 为每增加 1cm 吃水对应的排水量变化(t/cm)，MTC 为产生 1c: TPC is the change in displacement for each additional centimetre of draught in t/cm, while MTC is the moment needed to produce 1 cm of trim in t·m/cm; the two reflect loading sensitivity in the vertical and longitudinal directions respectively.
map.关于「船舶排水/载重吨计算」: About Vessel Displacement and Deadweight Calculation
map.依据船舶主尺度与吃水，计算排水量、载重吨（DWT）、每厘米吃水吨数（TPC）、每: From the principal dimensions and draught of the vessel, it calculates displacement, deadweight DWT, tonnes per centimetre immersion TPC, moment to change trim by one centimetre MTC, plus trim and midship deformation; it suits draft survey and loading estimation. It runs entirely in the browser and data is not uploaded.
map.“均值的均值”吃水修正: Draught correction using the mean of means
map.纵倾方向与中拱/中垂判定: Trim direction and hogging or sagging judgement
map.平均吃水 T_mean = (首吃水 + 6×中吃水 + 尾吃水) ÷ 8: Mean draft T_mean = (forward draft + 6 × midship draft + aft draft) ÷ 8
map.水线面系数 Cw：未输入或 ≤0 时由 (2Cb+1)/3 估算: Waterplane coefficient Cw: estimated as (2Cb+1)/3 when blank or ≤0
map.排水量 Δ = Cb × LBP × 型宽 × T_mean × 水密度（吨）: Displacement Δ = Cb × LBP × breadth × T_mean × water density (t)
map.水线面面积 Aw = Cw × LBP × 型宽: Waterplane area Aw = Cw × LBP × breadth
map.每厘米吃水吨 TPC = Aw × ρ ÷ 100（t/cm）: Tonnes per centimetre TPC = Aw × ρ ÷ 100 (t/cm)
map.纵稳心高 BMl = Cw²L² ÷ (12·Cb·T)；本工具取 GML =: Longitudinal metacentric height BMl = Cw²L² ÷ (12·Cb·T); this tool uses GML = BMl
map.每厘米纵倾力矩 MTC = Δ × GML ÷ (100 × LBP)（t·m/: Moment to change trim by 1 cm MTC = Δ × GML ÷ (100 × LBP) (t·m/cm)
map.改变 1cm 纵倾需首尾移动重量 = MTC × 100 ÷ LBP: Weight to shift fore/aft for a 1 cm trim change = MTC × 100 ÷ LBP
map.纵倾 = 尾吃水 − 首吃水（正值尾倾）: Trim = aft draft − forward draft (positive = by stern)
map.中部变形 = 中吃水 − (首+尾)/2，>0.01m 中拱、<−0.01m 中: Midship deflection = midship draft − (forward + aft)/2; >0.01 m hogging, <−0.01 m sagging
map.约束：LBP、型宽、吃水、Cb、水密度均须 > 0: Constraint: LBP, breadth, draft, Cb and water density must all be > 0
map.改变 1cm 纵倾需首尾移动重量 = MTC ÷ LBP: Weight to shift between fore and aft to change trim by 1 cm = MTC ÷ LBP
map.中部变形 = (首+尾)/2 − 中吃水，>0.01m 中拱、<−0.01m 中: Midship deflection = (fore + aft)/2 − midship draft; >0.01 m hogging, <−0.01 m sagging
map.方形系数 Cb 必须在 0（不含）到 1（含）之间；本页不会把越界值静默截断，请: Block coefficient Cb must be in (0,1]; out-of-range values are not silently clamped.
map.水线面系数 Cw 必须在 0（不含）到 1（含）之间；留空或 ≤0 才会按 (2: Waterplane coefficient Cw must be in (0,1]; only blank or ≤0 values use the (2Cb+1)/3 estimate.
map.方形系数 Cb 须在 (0,1]；水线面系数 Cw 须在 (0,1]，留空或 ≤: Block coefficient Cb must be within (0,1]; waterplane coefficient Cw must be within (0,1]. Leave it blank or ≤0 to estimate it as (2Cb+1)/3; out-of-range values are not silently clipped or replaced.
map.纵稳心高 BMl = Cw²L² ÷ (12·Cb·T)；GML 默认取 BM_: Longitudinal metacentric radius BM_L = Cw²L² ÷ (12·Cb·T). GML defaults to BM_L; enter an actual hydrostatic GML to override it.
map.改变 1cm 纵倾需首尾移动重量 = MTC ÷ 移动距离（默认 LBP）: Weight to shift fore/aft for 1 cm trim change = MTC ÷ shift distance (defaults to LBP).
map.当前载荷估算 = 排水量 − 空船重量（不是设计或允许最大载重吨 DWT）: Current load estimate = displacement − lightship weight (not the design or allowable deadweight DWT).
map.实际纵稳心高 GML（m，选填）: Actual longitudinal metacentric height GML (m, optional)
map.依据船舶主尺度与吃水，计算排水量、当前载荷（DWT）、每厘米吃水吨数（TPC）、: Estimate displacement, current load, tonnes per centimetre immersion (TPC), moment to change trim (MTC), trim and amidships deflection from principal dimensions and draft. It is a draft-survey and loading estimate, not a deadweight rating. Runs entirely in the browser; no data is uploaded.
map.📚 深度解析：船舶排水量与当前载荷估算: 📚 In-depth analysis: Vessel Displacement and Current Load Estimate
map.载荷估算时，用当前吃水排水量减去空船重量得到“当前载荷”，不能把它当设计或最大载: For a load estimate, subtract lightship weight from displacement at the current draft; this is the current load, not the design or maximum deadweight DWT.
map.LBP=100m、型宽=16m、首/中/尾吃水=5.0/5.2/5.4m、方形系: LBP = 100 m, beam 16 m, forward/mid/aft drafts 5.0/5.2/5.4 m, block coefficient 0.7, seawater density 1.025: Cw = (2×0.7+1)/3 = 0.8, mean draft 5.20 m, displacement 5969.6 t, waterplane area 1280 m², TPC = 13.12 t/cm, GML ≈ 146.5 m, MTC = 87.47 t·m/cm; trim 0.4 m by stern, with a 2000 t lightship the current load estimate is 3969.6 t (not DWT); shifting weight for 1 cm trim by the LBP assumption needs about 87.5 t, or MTC÷distance if the distance differs.
map.GML 和移动重量能直接用于配载吗？: Can GML and shifted weight be used directly for loading?
map.GML 默认按 BM_L 估算，忽略重心与浮心位置；可输入实际静水力 GML 覆: GML defaults to BM_L, ignoring centre of gravity and buoyancy; enter an actual hydrostatic GML to override it. Shifted weight assumes the fore-aft distance equals LBP by default and can use the actual distance. A professional must still verify the results against complete hydrostatic data.
